'''Isabela's 4th congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.<ref name="congleg">{{cite web|title=Roster of Philippine legislators|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=February 25, 2023|archive-date=March 16, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province|url-status=dead}}</ref> The district consists of the independent component city of [[Santiago, Isabela|Santiago]] and the municipalities of [[Cordon, Isabela|Cordon]], [[Dinapigue, Isabela|Dinapigue]], [[Jones, Isabela|Jones]], and [[San Agustin, Isabela|San Agustin]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Joseph Tan (politician)|Joseph S. Tan]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).<ref name="congmem">{{cite web|title=House Members|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/search.php?id=tan-j|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=February 25, 2023}}</ref>

Prior to its redistricting effective 2019, which increased the province's districts to six, it consisted of the city of [[Santiago, Isabela|Santiago]] and the municipalities of Cordon, Dinapigue, [[Echague, Isabela|Echague]], Jones, [[Ramon, Isabela|Ramon]], San Agustin, and [[San Isidro, Isabela|San Isidro]].
